title: register.v<N>.json
description: Sealed truth for one target at one version. Defect ids are stable across versions; a new version adds defects or non-defects and never renumbers or removes.

adjudicator.description: Person or model with effort and tools.

saw_reviewer_output.description: False for a pre-dispatch seal; true for a post-grid revision adjudicating a surfaced claim.

demonstration.description: The reproduction performed, or 'static' with the reasoning.

clean_basis.description: For a clean target: what was executed and compared to establish it.

leakage.description: Commits, issues, and comments that reveal the answer and must stay out of reviewer reach.

preexisting_hints.description: Pre-cutoff review-record comments that gesture at a defect or at the ground-truth surface; disclosed because they are in every arm's packet.

limits.description: The adjudicator's stated confidence limits and unresolved reproductions.

source.description: Path of the prose register this was converted from, when applicable.
